name: Algimia de Almonacid (Spain)
description: Tierced per bend sinister red, yellow and white, the red charged with a yellow castle bearing a white flag.
history: The flag was approved by resolution of 9 March 2004 of the conseller de Justícia i Administracions Públiques, published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat Valenciana; it is a flag of 2:3, tierced per bend sinister, with the castle of the arms, which are gules a castle or with a flag argent on the central tower.

features.role: broad yellow band between the red and the white
castle with a white flag on the central tower
